GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 10l off, imporved turn, Straightened Up 5l off, plodded home # never a threat
Jumped Ok well back Settled Down last 10 Lengths 1200m last 12 Lengths 800m last 12 Lengths home turn last rails run Straight ran on final 200m # last/ran on 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rider stated she was obliged to restrain from outside barrier and settled at rear. Added remained near rail approaching home turn rather than shifting to extreme outside and obtained clear running in early straight but unable to apply full vigour until inside 200m whereby mount finished fairly.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Not pushed early & raced keenly Worse than midfield Two Wide (5L from lead). Stayed same until back 1 length @ 600m. Out Four Wide @ 500m & pushed to quicken Six Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 8W @ 250m & worked home fairly in last 150m. # Last 150m OK.
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 7th fence 8 Lengths 600m 6th 6 Lengths home turn 6th rails run Straight to look winner until last stride # good ride/run

Jumped Ok , Caught 3 Wide No Cover Worse than midfield 6 Lengths 1000m, came to Middle Of Track soon after Straightening Up and loomed to win, took over 200m but he was bit green, held off late challenge for strong win # green/clear win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages. Shifted in under pressure down the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 8 Lengths Two Wide , made no ground to Turn and Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. Jockey stated it settled rearward behind a moderate tempo, was left flat-footed when the field sprinted on straightening and was unable to make the necessary ground on the leading division down the straight. Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # slow out/got back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. When questioned, rdr stated that his mount settled at the rear of the field, behind a moderate tempo, and was left flat footed when the field sprinted on straightening. Rdr stated that his mount was unable to make the necessary ground on the leading division down the straight. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly then hampered & Settled Down last on fence 9 Lengths from the lead, Drifted Back to 10 Lengths turning, cut corner and steere only 2-3 Wide making ground in Straight # got too far back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hampered and carried inwards shortly after the start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Just a Bit Slow Out , Settled Down on rail Equal Last about 9 Lengths @ 1000m. last into Straight fanning Wide to Clear . Just Held Ground # always well back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Bumped with another runner soon after the start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped OK. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (8L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken Four Wide @ 400m. Chasing 3 Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Held ground 3 Wide in straight. # Fair for easier
Jumped Ok , Drifted Back in second half rails 8 Lengths 800m, angled off fence Straightening Up but did not finish well enough # did not finish off
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 6 Lengths Two Wide turning, Made Ground in Straight # battled on fairly
